title: gpui Motion Plan
description: A flat inventory of every animated surface in a native Rust gpui app, checked against the rust-gpui-motion skill's Quality Gates by scripts/motion_audit.mjs.

name.description: Human-readable identifier for the animated surface, e.g. 'spawn-card-expand' or 'fleet-status-dot'.

kind.description: micro = one-shot/looping atom (glow, breathing dot, hover); transition = surface changes shape or identity; bespoke = below the widget layer (paint/canvas/Vello/wgpu).

usesTransform.description: True if this surface's implementation reaches for scale()/translate()/rotate() or a transform property. gpui 0.2.x has none of these on div — this must always be false.

animatesLayoutInHotRender.description: True if the surface animates width/height/px/insets inside a view that re-renders frequently, forcing a full element-tree re-layout every frame.

owners.description: Count of distinct motion drivers (with_animation calls or transition state machines) writing this surface's animated properties. Must be exactly 1.

handled.description: True if a reduced-motion branch exists at all (there is no @media fallback in gpui; this must be decided explicitly).

preservesOrientation.description: True if the reduced-motion branch still communicates final state (a fade or hint), rather than silently snapping with no cue.

present.description: True if this surface uses Animation::new(..).repeat().

scopedToLeaf.description: True if the repeat() loop is mounted on the smallest leaf view that needs it, not high in the tree. Required when present is true.

pausesWhenIdle.description: True if the repeat() loop is paused or unmounted when its surface is idle/off-screen. Required when present is true.

easing.description: Only curves confirmed to exist in gpui 0.2.x's with_easing(). Web curve names (ease_out, cubic-bezier, spring physics) do not port.

interruptible.description: True if a mid-flight change retargets the current value instead of restarting at 0. Required for kind: transition surfaces (shape/identity change).
